    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">记一次Webshell流量分析2 | 添柴不加火</span>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        一道关于蚁剑流量的CTF题目
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p></p><div class="toc"><div class="toc-container-header">目录</div><ul><li><a href="#题目" rel="noopener nofollow">题目</a></li><li><a href="#流量分析" rel="noopener nofollow">流量分析</a></li></ul></div><p></p>
<h2 id="题目">题目</h2>
<p>这是一道ctf题目，只需要找到flag即可。</p>
<h2 id="流量分析">流量分析</h2>
<p>首先打开流量包，协议分级，发现HTTP流占比较多<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153555659-2078033629.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>过滤HTTP流，大致看一下，发现上传了php文件<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153603316-1737403010.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>过滤POST请求<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153610167-1361457063.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>分析第一个HTTP流，发现一句话木马，典型的蚁剑流量<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153618346-745907907.png" alt="4" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>继续往下分析，解密蚁剑流量<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153626482-397147197.png" alt="5" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>继续分析，发现上传了一张图片，但是png头前面有其他字符，结尾也是，将其删除<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153634147-672709271.png" alt="6" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>找到其返回包，对text data进行“显示分组字节”操作，然后通过右下角的开始、结束进行删除多余字符串<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153641514-83831352.png" alt="7" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153646855-178183946.png" alt="8" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>删除之后，点击显示为“图像”<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153654696-1548779580.png" alt="9" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153700316-416130122.png" alt="10" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>其实也可以写脚本删除多于字符并输出图像，脚本如下：</p>
<details>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code>with open('A:/下载/1.txt', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

# 查找标识符位置（注意标识符在响应体中是以文本形式存在的，需处理编码）
# 响应体中的标识符是 "ebd5863dd2" 和 "20b0e2946"
start_marker = b'ebd5863dd2'
end_marker = b'20b0e2946'

start = data.find(start_marker) + len(start_marker)
end = data.find(end_marker, start)

if start != -1 and end != -1:
    png_data = data[start:end]
    with open('A:/下载/output.png', 'wb') as out:
        out.write(png_data)
    print("图片已保存为 output.png")
else:
    print("未找到标识符")
</code></pre>
</details>
<p>得到密钥key<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153708875-1281893848.png" alt="11" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>继续分析流量，发现最后有一个压缩包，将其导出并解密，得到flag<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153715944-744803635.png" alt="12" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202604/3763804-20260401153720909-316385717.png" alt="13" loading="lazy"></p>
